question: Can the canonical scientific archive and method history grow substantially without proportional growth in the active LLM context for an unchanged target, while preserving all mandatory epistemic material and useful target coverage?
core_invariant: storage growth must not imply prompt growth

primary_quantities.active_token_ratio: active prompt/context tokens / registered input budget
primary_quantities.archive_context_ratio: active selected tokens / total declared archive token cost
primary_quantities.weighted_epistemic_density: weighted new required/relevant coverage / active selected tokens
primary_quantities.distractor_growth_slope: Delta active selected tokens / Delta irrelevant archive records for fixed target
primary_quantities.prompt_padding_rate: selected optional token mass with zero marginal target coverage / selected optional token mass
primary_quantities.rehydration_traceability: fraction of selected compact/lossy views with valid raw-source reconstruction lineage

known_answer_worlds.setup: same mandatory and target-fiber records; add semantically novel distractor records assigned only to unrelated fibers
add many same-fiber records whose coverage atoms duplicate already selected atoms
expected: used tokens unchanged after complete target coverage

known_answer_worlds.setup: add a same-fiber record containing a newly registered required coverage atom
expected: context grows only if needed to satisfy the new registered requirement

known_answer_worlds.expected: mandatory negative evidence retained regardless of marginal utility ranking
benchmark should expose possible contamination/cost growth; strict scale-invariance claim requires a target/query-conditioned retrieval boundary
CANNOT_CHECK for strict model-budget certification; estimates remain estimates

success_for_current_support_layer: strict token claims are scoped to exact counter/profile when executed
global archive is never inserted wholesale into an LLM prompt
coding-agent recurring instructions remain a thin router rather than embedding the full framework
real_project_falsifier: If active context/token cost grows materially with irrelevant archive size, or RAKL loses mandatory evidence/reconstruction quality compared with a simpler retrieval/context policy under matched budgets, the current memory/context architecture is not adequate for long-horizon use and must reopen before a strong efficiency claim.
authority_boundary: engineering efficiency only; token efficiency does not establish scientific correctness
